description: This file contains unit tests for runtime versioning strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system, focusing on compatibility and selector strategy modifications.

classes.name: RuntimeStrategyChangeTests
classes.description: A test class to verify runtime changes to versioning and compatibility strategies within an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: ChangeCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the compatibility strategy at runtime and its effect on grain version activation.

methods.name: ChangeVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the version selector strategy dynamically and observing grain activation behavior.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultVersionCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Tests altering the default compatibility strategy and its impact on existing and new grains.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Tests modifying the default version selector strategy and subsequent grain activation versions.
